verdict.rationale: Warp documents running many agents concurrently across repos or tasks, and Factories that use a fleet of cloud agents to work many requests into pull requests. This is a form of fan-out across many items. It is not a documented bulk-operation primitive such as applying one action to a selected set of items in a single command. missing for 10: an explicit bulk/batch operation feature, details on how items are selected and how results are aggregated, and independent or hands-on corroboration of large-scale parallel runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Parallelism: Run many agents concurrently across repos or tasks
